		//Question 6 — Palindrome Number
		
		
		  int num=1221; 
		  int palindrome=num;
		  int last = 0; 
		  int pal = 0;
		  for(int i=1;i<=4;i++) 
		  	{ 
			  last = num%10;
			  pal=last+(pal*10);
			  num=num/10; 
			  }
		  //System.out.print(pal); 
		  if(pal==palindrome)
			  System.out.println(pal+" is a palindrome");
		  else
